If any figure differs from the expectation above, do NOT run the verifier: record a failure entry with the artifact paths and diagnose under the ladder (L0 retry once, then L1). The human replay loader (src/arc_plasticity/evaluation/human_replays.py) targets the documented recorder format only (one JSON event per action with game_id and levels_completed at top level or under data; participant, session id and timestamp via candidate key lists). The released dataset's real schema is unknown; the ingestion preflight will surface a mismatch as parse failures (thresholded at 0), and the adapter is then extended under the ladder with the field mapping recorded in input_manifest.json, as G2.yaml ingestion_paths requires.

G2.4 readings (2026-09-04, recorded in the ledger decision entry): replays matched to official games by stem with the replay game ids per stem recorded in input_manifest.json; metrics.csv carries two rows per (game, level) because the contract fixes two columns, environment_results.csv the joint per-level row; the G2 exclusion bounds are the G0 pre-registration's (its digest is recorded in the check) because G2.yaml's determinism_protocol carries none; a refused E020 run exits 2 before any directory exists (runner.preflight hook in scripts/run_experiment.py). The E020 runner has only been exercised on a synthetic world (tests/g2_synthetic.py, recorder format); the released dataset's real schema may differ and would surface as parse failures in the manifest builder's totals before any graded run.

Released human-replay schema (2026-09-04, G2.6 survey, all 342 files): <uuid>.recording.jsonl nested raw/arc_agi_3_public_demo_human_testing/<stem>/; one session per file; records {timestamp, data}; frame records carry action_input, frame, state, levels_completed, win_levels, guid, full_reset, available_actions, game_id; the last record is the toolkit scorecard (data.cards); no participant identity anywhere (participant_ids_available false); 23 older-format files use string action ids. Record 1 is the play-start frame, not an issued action (ledger G2.6 decision (a), basis arc_agi.scorecard.Card).
